'''2011 German National Championship David Destefanis DS Executor: Meditation Chamber''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Meditation Chamber|Dagobah-D-executormeditationchamber.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Katana Flops
* '''Username:''' DDT
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
